title: SU2 Unsteady NACA0012 tutorial restart output
license: LGPL-2.1 (upstream repository LICENSE retained in source/)
time_note: Times derived as source index * TIME_STEP using SU2 7.0.2 output convention; binary restarts have no embedded timestamp or producer revision.
transformations: No solver was run. No synthetic fields or frames added.
Velocity computed as momentum / density at original nodes. Pressure and density copied unchanged.
Source quadrilaterals split along diagonal 0-2 for barycentric interpolation.
Runtime maps source (x,y) to Unreal (X=x-0.5,Z=y); Y is an extruded display dimension with no CFD variation.
Source mesh airfoil boundary is extruded for visualization. Scene box crops the much larger source domain.
No interpolation in time. Playback holds each recorded snapshot for one wall-clock second.
pressure_note: Actual restart pressure is retained; do not substitute the config freestream pressure for the Reynolds-initialized field.
